images.caption: Road on the eastern side of the Northern Lights Shopping Center in Economy, Pennsylvania, United States.  A JC Penney store was formerly located here, but the building was demolished to build this roa

facade.notes: an old centre being redeveloped: a blank painted-block end wall, a standing-seam metal canopy over an empty storefront; a new private access road with lamp posts, curbed islands with new trees and construction barrels; cracked old parking asphalt in the foreground

why.note: a dying 1950s-60s centre: vacancies, then a redevelopment road through the old parking field
modern codes require curbed landscape islands in parking fields
